data.name: SqlSelectCommand1.CommandText
data.value: SELECT InsuredGUID, BusinessTypeID, FEIN, StatusID, DBA, SSN, CorporationName, Salutation, FirstName, MiddleName, LastName, InsuredID, Soundex, PolicyName, DOB, RiskID, CarrierId, TaxID, DNBNumber, OFACCleared, GenderID, StatusChangeReasonComment, OfacClearedDate, OptOut FROM tblInsureds WHERE (InsuredGUID = @InsuredGuid)

data.name: SqlSelectCommand3.CommandText
data.value: SELECT tblInsuredLocations.InsuredLocationGUID, tblInsuredLocations.InsuredGUID, tblInsuredLocations.DeliveryMethodID, tblInsuredLocations.Name, tblInsuredLocations.Address1, tblInsuredLocations.Address2, tblInsuredLocations.ZipPlus, REPLACE(tblInsuredLocations.Phone, '-', '') AS Phone, REPLACE(tblInsuredLocations.Fax, '-', '') AS Fax, tblInsuredLocations.WebSite, tblInsuredLocations.DateAdded, tblInsuredLocations.LocationTypeID, tblInsuredLocations.Code, tblInsuredLocations.Hidden, tblInsuredLocations.City, tblInsuredLocations.County, tblInsuredLocations.State, tblInsuredLocations.ZipCode, tblInsuredLocations.Email, tblInsuredLocations.Region, tblInsuredLocations.ISOCountryCode, tblInsuredLocations.AddedBy, tblUsers.Name_LastFirst, REPLACE(tblInsuredLocations.MobileNumber, '-', '') AS MobileNumber, tblInsuredLocations.NumEmployees, tblInsuredLocations.GrossWrittenPremium, tblInsuredLocations.LocationSource, tblInsuredLocations.Owner, tblInsuredLocations.ProductionPotential, tblInsuredLocations.ProducerRankingID, tblInsuredLocations.NumWholesaleRelationship, tblInsuredLocations.AgreementEffectiveDate, tblInsuredLocations.SetProcedureToEnage, tblInsuredLocations.ApproveWholesalersList, tblInsuredLocations.ReferredBYProdLocation, tblInsuredLocations.SpecFocusDept, tblInsuredLocations.Expertise, tblInsuredLocations.WholesaleRelationships, tblInsuredLocations.OptOut, tblInsuredLocations.CountryCodeforPhone, tblInsuredLocations.CountryCodeforFax, tblInsuredLocations.CountryCodeforMobile FROM tblInsuredLocations LEFT OUTER JOIN tblUsers ON tblInsuredLocations.AddedBy = tblUsers.UserGUID WHERE (tblInsuredLocations.Hidden = 0) AND (tblInsuredLocations.InsuredGUID = @InsuredGuid) ORDER BY tblInsuredLocations.Name

data.name: SqlUpdateCommand1.CommandText
